slug: 2025-12-26 Review of Gambia's Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2025

facts.fact: TechHive Advisory reviews the Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act as enacted, concluding a legislative process stalled for several years; it gives no commencement date (published 2025-12-26, no other date).
facts.system: Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act 2025

facts.fact: The review says the Act establishes an independent oversight Commission; it does not say the Commission has been appointed (published 2025-12-26, no other date).
